text:
Nisha Patel: Heads up — customer reported duplicate partial toolcall charges when a streaming session reconnects mid-toolcall. Repro seems to be: client reconnect -> server resumes suffix -> provisional tokens don't get deduped. Anyone seen this before?

Kevin Cho: ouch. any model swap or routing fallback involved? :eyes:

Nisha Patel: no model swap. plain reconnect after a transient network blip, route sticky to same broker. billing shows two provisional counts then one confirmed.

Liam O'Connor: can you paste the trace + a few ledger lines?

Nisha Patel: sure. trace id: trace_2026_03_21_9932

```
# simplified ledger excerpt
2026-03-21T14:02:10Z TRACE trace_2026_03_21_9932 session=0x7f toolcall_id=tc-9a provisional_tokens=66
2026-03-21T14:02:12Z INFO resume suffix_index=34 session=0x7f replayed_tokens=40
2026-03-21T14:02:13Z TRACE trace_2026_03_21_9932 session=0x7f toolcall_confirm toolcall_id=tc-9a confirmed_tokens=66
# accounting later shows provisional 66 + confirmed 66 for same toolcall
```

billing-bot: Detected anomaly for session=0x7f trace_2026_03_21_9932 — provisional: 66, confirmed: 66, provisional not cleared on replay -> potential double-bill. Logged as alert #BILL-7421.

Maya Singh: this smells like a handoff/replay gap: when suffix replay consumes prefix that was marked provisional, we don't reconcile the provisional marker. Need idempotency/ownership check on handoff path.

Kevin Cho: quick thought: if reconnect includes same toolcall idempotency token, we should treat overlapping provisional ranges as already-claimed and avoid re-crediting. But careful — if the reconnect is to a different route, we need to ensure we don't undercharge.

Liam O'Connor: agreed. also console/ops couldn't see provisional vs confirmed per-route easily. that's why this slipped through. We should surface provisional counts on the per-route dashboard and add a reconciliation alert.

Maya Singh: I'll prototype adding a debug metric: billing.provisional_overlap_count and a route-level gauge that increments on suffix replay when overlap detected. Can add console toggle to show provisional breakdown.

Nisha Patel: I'll create a minimal repro (client shim that reconnects during toolcall) and attach logs + network capture. Gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/repro-1719993210 :thumbsup:

Kevin Cho: assign to eng-platform, set priority P2 for the patch (metric + conservative dedupe). I'll also ping billing for a hold on reconciliation for affected customer until we confirm fixes. @billing-bot fyi.

billing-bot: Acknowledged. Placing temporary hold and flagging ledger entries for manual review. Ticket BILL-7421 updated.

Nisha Patel: thanks all — creating GH issue now with repro, trace, and suggested metric names. Will link PR when ready.

Kevin Cho: sounds good. small follow-ups: add unit test for idempotency token overlap and a console note in rollout docs to guide on interpreting provisional spikes.

Maya Singh: will do.

Liam O'Connor: leaving notes for oncall: if you see provisional spike + confirm without net delta, escalate to eng-platform + billing.

Nisha Patel: done — issue #4237 created: https://redwood.internal/issue/4237. Closing thread for now but will update when PR lands.
